name: Jharkhand Nirman Karmakar Mrityu/Durghatana Sahayata Yojana
benefit:
In case of death in an accident, ₹ 5,00,000/-.
In case of complete disability in an accident, ₹ 3,00,000/-.
In case of partial disability in an accident, ₹ 2,00,000/-.
In case of normal death, ₹ 1,00,000/-.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a domicile in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should be a registered Construction Worker (Nirman Shramik / Nirman Karmakar).
1. The applicant should be in the age group of 18-60 years.
1. The applicant should have worked for at least 90 days.
